paite: Pharisaite lak a mi, Judate vaihawmpa, amin Nikodem a-om hi.
heading: Jesu Leh Nikodem Houlimna
english: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

paite: Huai mi zan in Jesu kiang ah ahong a, akiang ah, "Rabbi, Pathian a kipan hong pai sinsakpa na hi chih ka thei uhi. Pathian na kiang a om lou hileh hiai thillamdang na hihte kuamah in ahihthei kei ding," achi hi.
english: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mi kuapeuh apianthak keileh Pathian lalgam amu thei kei," achi hi.
english: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Nikodem in akiang ah, "Mi atek nung in bangchi in apiangthak thei dia? Anu sung a nihvei lut in apiang thei dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, "Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh tui a leh Kha a apianthak keileh Pathian lalgam alut thei kei hi.
english: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

paite: Sa suan peuhmah sa ahi a, Kha suan peuhmah kha ahi.
english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

paite: Na pianthak ngeingei ding ahi ka hon chih lamdang sa ke'n.
english: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’

paite: Huih a-utna peuh ah anung a, aging na za hi, himahleh koi a kipan hong pai ahia, koi ah ahia ahoh ding chih na thei ngal kei a; kuapeuh Kha a piang huchibang mah in a-om hi," achi hi.
english: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

paite: Nikodem in adawng a, "Hiai bangchi in a-om thei dia?" achi hi.
english: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Israelte sinsakpa na hi ngal a, huaite na thei kei maw?
english: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kou ka theih uh ka gen ua, ka muh uh ka theisak uh; himahleh ka thu theihsak uh na sang kei uhi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

paite: Lei lam thil ka hon hilh bawn gingtaloute'n, van lam thil hon hilh leng bangchi in na gingta ding ua?
english: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

paite: Mihing Tapa, van a ompa leh van a kipan hong sukpa kia lou ngal kuamah van ah akahtou ngei kei.
english: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

paite: "Huan Mosi in gamdai a gul akhaikang bang in, Mihing Tapa khaikang in a-om ding hi.
english: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

paite: Kuapeuh agingta in amah ziak a tangtawn hinna aneihna ding in.
english: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

paite: Pathian in khovel a-it mahmah ziak in, a Tapa tang neihsun apia hi. Kuapeuh amah gingtate amanthat louh ua, tangtawn hinna aneih zawkna ding un.
english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

paite: Khovel siam louh tangsak ding in Pathian in khovel ah a Tapa asawl kei, khovel amah vang a ahintheihna ding in asawl ahi zaw hi.
english: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

paite: "Kuapeuh amah gingta siam louh in a-om kei ding a, kuapeuh agingta lou, tu a kipan siam louh in a-om pah ngal hi; Pathian Tapa tang neihsun min agintak louh ziak in.
english: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

paite: Hiai siamlouhna ahi, khovel ah vak ahong a, himahleh mi'n vak sang in mial a-itzaw uh; athilhihte uh agitlouh ziak in.
english: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

paite: Kuapeuh thil gilou hih in vak aho nak, vak ah leng ahong pai kei hi; huchi lou in zaw athilhihte alang kha ding hi.
english: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

paite: Himahleh kuapeuh adik hihte athilhih uh Pathian ziak a hih ahi, chih alatna ding in vak ah ahong pai uhi," achi hi.
english: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

paite: Huai khit in Jesu anungzuite toh Judia gam ah ahoh ua, huai ah Jesu akiang uah a-om nilouh a, abaptis zel uhi.
heading: Jesu Leh Johan
english: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

paite: Johan in leng Ainon ah, Salim kho kiang ah abaptis sam a, huai a tui atam ziak in mi ahong ua, baptisma atang uhi.
english: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

paite: Hiai hun in Johan suangkul a khum ahi nai kei hi.
english: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

paite: Huan Johan nungzuite leh Juda khenkhat silsiang thu ah akisel uhi.
english: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

paite: Johan kiang ah ahong pai ua, akiang ah, "Rabbi, Jordan gal a na kiang a om, athu mi na theihsakpa'n, ngai dih, mi abaptis a, akiang ah mi tengteng ahong pai uh," achi uhi.
english: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

paite: Johan in adawng a, "Van a pan a piak ahihkeileh mihing in bangmah anei thei kei uhi.
english: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

paite: Kei Khrist ka hi kei, ama a misawl ka hi, ka chih, noumau mahmah hon theihpihte na hi uhi.
english: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

paite: Mouneipa zaw mounu pasal ahi; himahleh mouneipa lawm ding a athu za mouneipa aw ziak in akipak mahmah a, ka kipahna atangtungta hi.
english: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

paite: Amah alian semsem ding a, kei bel ka neu hiaihiai ding," achi hi.
english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

paite: "Tunglam a kipan hong pai zaw mi tengteng sang a tungnungpen ahi; lei a kipan bel lei a ahi a, lei lam thu agen a, van a kipan a hong paipa zaw mi tengteng sang a tungnungpen ahi.
heading: Van A Pan Hong Paipa
english: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

paite: Amuh leh azak peuh atheisak hi; kuamah in athu theihsak ataksang kei uhi.
english: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

paite: Athu theihsak taksangmi in, Pathian midiktat ahi, chih akipsak hi.
english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

paite: Pathian sawl in Pathian thu agen hi; ama'n zaw teh chitchiat in Kha ape ngal kei a.
english: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

paite: Pa in Tapa a-it a, akhut ah bangkim avek in apeta hi.
english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

paite: Kuapeuh Tapa gingta in tangtawn hinna anei; himahleh Tapa gingta lou in hinna anei kei ding a, Pathian thangpaihna atung ah a-om zaw," achi hi.
english: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”
